title: A Surprising Day
description: Practise the past simple, sequencing words and superlatives, then write a short story about a surprising day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: When I opened the door, all my friends ___ 'Surprise!'
exercises.explanation: The story is in the past, so use the past simple: shout - shouted.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My mum ___ (make) a huge chocolate cake.
exercises.explanation: "Make" is irregular: make - made.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: It was the best day of my life.
Was it the best day of my life?
exercises.explanation: Superlative + "of" + a period of time: the best day of my life.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I didn't knew about the party.
answers: I didn't know about the party.
I did not know about the party.
exercises.explanation: After "didn't" use the base form of the verb: didn't know.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We ate the cake. ___ we danced in the living room.
exercises.explanation: "Then" introduces the next event in time order.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one preposition.
exercises.text: It happened ___ my birthday last year.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" with special days and dates: on my birthday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I ___ TV when the doorbell rang.
exercises.explanation: We use the past continuous (was/were + -ing) for an action in progress when another short action happened. With "I" we use "was".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My best friend ___ (bring) me some flowers.
exercises.explanation: "Bring" is irregular: bring - brought. Do not confuse it with "buy - bought".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: When "who" is the subject, we do not use "did": Who organised the party?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There were much people in our living room.
answers: There were many people in our living room.
There were a lot of people in our living room.
There were lots of people in our living room.
exercises.explanation: "People" is a plural countable noun, so we use "many" or "a lot of", not "much".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I was very surprised, ___ I couldn't say anything.
exercises.explanation: "So" introduces a result: I was surprised (reason), so I couldn't speak (result).

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "some" or "any".
exercises.text: My dad gave me ___ money to buy a new bike.
exercises.explanation: We use "some" in positive sentences with uncountable nouns like "money".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Subject + was/were + -ing: My friends were waiting outside.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My little sister cryed because she was so happy.
answers: My little sister cried because she was so happy.
exercises.explanation: Verbs ending in consonant + y change y to i before -ed: cry - cried.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I'm sure I ___ never forget this day.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb for predictions, often after "I'm sure" or "I think".

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one preposition.
exercises.text: There was a big "Happy Birthday" banner ___ the wall.
exercises.explanation: We use "on" for things touching a surface: on the wall, on the door.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: "After that" shows the next event in a story. It usually goes at the start, followed by a comma.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: "Everyone" is singular, so we use "was": Everyone was happy.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: The party started ___ seven o'clock in the evening.
exercises.explanation: We use "at" with clock times: at seven o'clock.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Next year I going to have a surprise party for my mum.
answers: Next year I am going to have a surprise party for my mum.
exercises.explanation: "Going to" needs am/is/are before it: I am going to have.

task.prompt: Write a short story that begins: 'It was a normal Saturday morning.'
contentPoints: Say where you were and what you were doing.
Describe the surprising thing that happened.
usefulLanguage: It was a normal Saturday morning.
It was the best day ever.
task.modelAnswer: It was a normal Saturday morning. I was in my room when my dad called me. 'Come downstairs!' he said. In the kitchen there was a small box on the table. I opened it and found a little brown puppy inside! I was so surprised that I couldn't speak. After that, we took him to the park and he played with a ball. In the evening, we called him Lucky. It was the best day ever.
